title: Stocks to buy in 2026 for long term: Senco Gold, Arvind among 5 stocks that could give 10-60% return - Brokerage Recommendations | The Economic Times
text:
Brokerages remain bullish on a host of stocks, with several names offering double-digit upside potential from current levels.We have collated a list of recommendations from top brokerage firms from ETNow and other sources:

Nuvama on LG Electronics India Ltd: Buy| Target Rs 1910 (vs Rs 1820)| LTP Rs 1578| Potential Upside 21%Nuvama has maintained a BUY rating on LG Electronics India and raised its target price to Rs 1,910 from Rs 1,820. The revised target indicates a potential upside of around 21% from the current market price of Rs 1,578.

Motilal Oswal on Apollo Hospitals: Buy| Target Rs 10160| LTP Rs 8595| Potential Upside 18%Motilal Oswal has retained its BUY rating on Apollo Hospitals with a target price of Rs 10,160, implying a potential upside of around 18% from the current market price of Rs 8,595.

Motilal Oswal on Max Financial Services Ltd: Buy| Target Rs 1860| LTP Rs 1512| Potential Upside 23%Motilal Oswal has maintained a BUY rating on Max Financial Services with a target price of Rs 1,860. The target suggests a potential upside of around 23% from the current market price of Rs 1,512.

Nuvama on Arvind Ltd: Buy| Target Rs 660| LTP Rs 555| Potential Upside 18%Nuvama has reiterated its BUY rating on Arvind with a target price of Rs 660, indicating a potential upside of around 18% from the current market price of Rs 555.

Emkay Global on Senco Gold: Buy| Target Rs 575| LTP Rs 352| Potential Upside 63%Emkay Global has maintained a BUY rating on Senco Gold with a target price of Rs 575, implying a significant potential upside of around 63% from the current market price of Rs 352.(Disclaimer: Recommendations, suggestions, views, and opinions given by experts are their own. These do not represent the views of the Economic Times)
